Soft pretzel bites dipped in bicarb water, sprinkled with rock salt and baked deep brown, served warm with a honey mustard dip. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Roll into ropes and cut into 3cm bites. Boil 2L water with 60g bicarb soda and dip the bites for 30 seconds. Sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Mix 3 tbsp Dijon, 2 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp mayonnaise for the dip.
M: Rice noodles fried with egg, tofu, tamarind and fish sauce, topped with peanuts and lime.

Flathead strips dusted in chilli and cumin, pan-fried crisp, in corn tortillas with cabbage slaw, lime crema, sliced radish and coriander. Cut 600g flathead fillets into strips and toss in 2 tbsp flour, 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin and salt. Mix 150g sour cream with the zest and juice of a lime. Toss a quarter red cabbage, shredded, with lime juice and salt. Pan-fry the fish in hot oil for 2 minutes a side. Warm 12 corn tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, crema, sliced radish and coriander.
W: the bright red A on everything
Red velvet cake batter piped into rounds, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, sandwiched together with cream cheese frosting.

Fresh lemon juice and strawberries blitzed with sugar syrup, poured over ice with cold sparkling water, sliced strawberries and mint. Dissolve 120g sugar in 120ml hot water and cool. Blitz 250g hulled strawberries with the syrup and strain into a big jug. Add the juice of 6 lemons and 1L cold sparkling water and stir. Fill four tall glasses with ice, a few sliced strawberries and mint leaves, then pour in the lemonade.

s.note: the red A Olive stitches onto her clothes
s.how: Cut pita bread into A shapes, brush with olive oil and dust with sumac. Bake at 200C for 8 minutes until crisp. Blend 2 roasted beetroot with a crushed garlic clove and 200g Greek yoghurt, then swirl a little extra yoghurt through the top.

s.note: the small town of Ojai, California
s.how: Warm 150g green olives and 150g kalamata olives gently in olive oil with strips of orange and lemon peel, sliced garlic, a pinch of chilli and a teaspoon of fennel seeds for 5 minutes. Tip into a bowl and serve warm with toothpicks.

m.how: Soak 300g flat rice noodles. Fry 200g firm tofu and 2 garlic cloves, add 2 eggs and scramble. Add the noodles, 3 tbsp tamarind, 2 tbsp fish sauce and 2 tbsp brown sugar and toss. Finish with 150g bean sprouts, 60g crushed peanuts and lime.

w.note: the bright red A on everything
w.how: Whisk 250g flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, a teaspoon of bicarb, 150g sugar, an egg, 125ml oil, 250ml buttermilk and red colouring to a thick batter. Pipe rounds and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Sandwich with cream cheese beaten with icing sugar.
